howItWorks.title: Go live in
howItWorks.description: From account creation to your first automated booking — we guide you through every step.

steps.title: Create Your Account
steps.desc: Sign up in under 60 seconds. Enter your business name, category, and city.
steps.detail: Your account is created instantly. The system guides you through a simple 5-step onboarding flow.

steps.title: Verify Your Identity (KYC)
steps.desc: Upload your national ID card (front & back) and record a 5-second selfie video.
steps.detail: Our team reviews your documents within 24 hours. You get an email the moment your account is activated.

steps.title: Build Your Business Profile
steps.desc: Choose a theme for your category, add your services with prices, and upload your gallery.
steps.detail: Your profile becomes your public booking page — shareable on WhatsApp, Instagram, and everywhere.

steps.title: Configure Your Operations
steps.desc: Set your working hours, breaks, rest intervals between appointments, and daily capacity.
steps.detail: Invite your staff via secure links. Each member gets role-based access and their own schedule.

steps.title: Share Your Booking Link
steps.desc: Share your unique Bookiify link on WhatsApp status, Instagram bio, Google Maps, or your website.
steps.detail: Clients book 24/7 without creating an account. You get instant notifications for every new booking.

steps.title: Manage & Grow Automatically
steps.desc: Reminders are sent, invoices generated, loyalty points awarded — all automatically.
steps.detail: Use the AI assistant and analytics to spot patterns and keep growing. Your business runs on autopilot.

faq.q: How long does KYC verification take?
faq.a: Our team reviews identity documents within 24 hours. You receive an email notification the moment your account is activated.

faq.q: Can customers book without creating an account?
faq.a: Yes. Bookiify is completely account-free for end customers. They visit your link, pick a service, choose a time, and confirm — no passwords, no app to download.

faq.q: What happens when a booking is cancelled?
faq.a: If the Smart Waitlist is enabled, the next eligible client is automatically offered the freed slot via a timed email invitation with a secure one-time link.

faq.q: Can I manage multiple staff members?
faq.a: Yes. You can invite unlimited staff with different roles — Manager, Receptionist, or Staff. Each gets a secure login link and role-appropriate dashboard access.
Currently Bookiify is focused on the Tunisian market with local city support and Tunisian payment integration. International expansion is on our roadmap.

items.title: Smart Online Booking
items.desc: Clients book 24/7 in 3 clicks — no account, no password required. Fully mobile-optimized with real-time slot availability and anti double-booking protection.

items.title: Live Queue Screen
items.desc: A TV display designed for your waiting room. Shows client positions, live session timers, and estimated wait times — updated in real-time via WebSocket.
features: Works on any TV or tablet

items.title: Consultation Management
items.desc: Start a real-time timed session with each client. Built-in countdown timer, in-session messaging, worker access, and instant completion marking.

items.title: Smart Waitlist
items.desc: When a booking is cancelled, the next eligible client is automatically offered the freed slot via a timed email invitation — zero empty slots.

items.title: Staff Management
items.desc: Invite your entire team via secure one-time links. Assign roles (Manager, Receptionist, Staff), set individual schedules, and deactivate access instantly.

items.title: Real-time Chat
items.desc: Built-in WebSocket messaging for owner-to-staff communication. Multiple rooms, typing indicators, unread badges, and push notifications.

items.title: Work Mode
items.desc: A simplified mobile-first daily operations view. Manage your live queue, handle walk-in clients, and let staff join via a secure link — no login needed.

items.title: Automated Reminders
items.desc: Clients receive automatic booking confirmations, 24-hour reminders, and 2-hour pre-appointment alerts. Owners get notified of every new booking.

items.title: Finance & Revenue Tracking
items.desc: Full financial dashboard with daily, weekly, and monthly revenue charts, transaction logs, service breakdowns, and period-over-period comparison.

items.title: Invoice Management
items.desc: Auto-generate branded invoices when bookings are completed. Send professional PDF invoices to clients by email. Track draft, sent, paid, and overdue.

items.title: Customer Loyalty Program
items.desc: Reward your regulars with points or stamp cards that earn free services and discounts. Runs automatically on every completed booking.

items.title: Recruitment System
items.desc: Post job openings that appear on the Bookiify Find Work discovery page. Receive applications, review candidates, and hire directly from your dashboard.

items.title: AI Smart Assistant
items.desc: A 24/7 AI advisor built directly into your dashboard. Get business strategy advice, marketing ideas, data insights, and customer-handling scripts instantly.

items.title: Analytics & Insights
items.desc: Deep-dive into booking trends, top services, completion rates, peak hours, and seasonal patterns. Make every decision backed by real data.

items.title: Website Builder
items.desc: 20+ professional templates for every service category. Add services, gallery, opening hours, and get a public booking page instantly — no coding needed.

items.title: Enterprise Security
items.desc: KYC identity verification, 2FA TOTP authentication, Redis session blacklisting, device fingerprinting, and a full security event audit log.
